text:
Maya: Quick heads up — planning a release announcement for next Wed (UTC). Need changelog, docs links, benchmark bullets, and canary timing. Looping in @alex @sam @jordan. Also planning webinar + dry-run Fri. Can you confirm availability?

Alex: We can freeze model changes by Tue EOD. Changelog will be published to the releases bucket after we tag the release.

Sam: Docs PR is open: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/452 — will finish edits today. Bench numbers need one approval from Eng-ML (ping @jordan).

Jordan: Marketing request: two short bullets for the blog (latency P50, % improvement vs previous release). Prefer percentage improvements rather than raw per-token costs.

Maya: Got it. Emily, can you draft the social post copy with % numbers only? Also we need a 1-line quote from @alex for the webinar slide.

Emily: Yep — will draft. Webinar dry-run Fri 10:00 PT. @alex can you do a 1-line comment: what to include?

Alex: 1-liner: "Redwood Inference reduces tail latency while cutting inference cost via smart batching and caching." Happy to tweak.

Sam: Changelog URL: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2.3.0/changelog.md
Docs URL (staging): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.0
Docs PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/452

Alex: Canary window: Thu 02:00–06:00 PT (low traffic) — we can route 5% traffic initially, then 25% after 30m if metrics stable.

Maya: Perfect. Can you paste the rollout policy snippet (copyable) here?

Alex: ```json
{
  "canary": {
    "start_pct": 5,
    "steps": [25, 50],
    "step_interval_mins": 30,
    "rollback_on": ["error_rate>1%", "latency_p95>1500ms"]
  }
}
```

Jordan: Also add a note in the changelog about fallback to a compatible model variant when GPU capacity is constrained (so customers degrade gracefully).

Sam: Added that to the PR — note under 'Behavioral changes' with a short line and link to runtime doc.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: Thu 02:00 PT — release v2.3.0. Tracking ID: deploy-2026-03-25-02

Maya: Thanks all. Action items: Emily social draft (today), Alex changelog + rollout snippet (EOD), Sam finish docs PR (EOD). Dry run Fri 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:

Alex: :thumbsup:

Sam: :v:

Emily: On it.
